checked_items.item: UCC21710-Q1 APWM duty mapping ('10 % at 0.6 V to 88 % at 4.5 V')
checked_items.evidence: SLUSDH8D: 'DAPWM VAIN = 0.6 V: 86.5 / 88 / 89.5 %; VAIN = 2.5 V: 48.5 / 50 / 51.5 %; VAIN = 4.5 V: 7.5 / 10 / 11.5 %' and text 'The duty cycle increases linearly from 10 % to 88 % while the AIN voltage decreases from 4.5 V to 0.6 V'.
checked_items.correction: Duty is 88 % at 0.6 V and 10 % at 4.5 V. The decode formula must be D = 0.88 - 0.200/V x (V_AIN - 0.6 V); with an NTC, duty rises as temperature rises. The OTP comparator sense and the eCAP mapping in the firmware contract must be inverted accordingly.

knowledge_misuse: No reference instance value was found copied as a derived design value. The only verbatim carry-overs are component choices shared with the references (TPS26400PWPR, UCC14141QDWNRQ1, UCC21710QDWRQ1, and TPS54302/TPS767D301/TPS3808 from V1) and the 100 uF protected-rail bulk capacitor, which coincides with CB-PR-001 alternative B's '100 uF 25 V tantalum' but is re-justified in the inrush calculation. The agent's applicability labels (KR-GD-008 exclusion invoked, CB-GD-003 and KR-SN-003 not applicable, KR-PR-003/KR-TH-003/KR-ISO-002 human-review) match the record texts.
required_changes: Correct the UCC21710-Q1 APWM polarity everywhere (temp_pwm_decode calculation, section 4/7 text, OTP comparator sense, eCAP decode in the firmware contract): SLUSDH8D gives 88 % duty at VAIN = 0.6 V and 10 % at 4.5 V, so D = 0.88 - 0.200/V x (V_AIN - 0.6 V) and duty rises with NTC temperature.

Reconcile the TPS3808 SENSE divider with the stated 4.5 V trip: 105 k / 10 k gives about 4.66 V at a 0.405 V threshold; either state 4.66 V (and re-check headroom against the TPS54302 5 V tolerance) or change R_top to about 101 k; confirm the G01 threshold from the TPS3808 datasheet.

Replace the 'not found' statements with datasheet values: SN74LV21A tpd max 12 ns at 3.3 V +/- 0.3 V (CL = 50 pF, over temperature); AO3400A RDS(on) max 48 mohm at VGS = 2.5 V; TPS2640 V(UVLOR) min 1.175 V and V(OVPR) min 1.17 V; UCC21710-Q1 RST/EN pull-down 28.5 / 55 / 113 kohm (not 50 kohm).

Fix the efuse_inrush combined-current expression: use the 12 V-side buck input current (about 0.29 A at 10.8 V) instead of P_in5 / 5 V; the total during the ramp is about 0.53 A, still below I_OL,min = 1.425 A.

State the UCC14141-Q1 full-load input-current condition correctly (200 mA specified over VVIN 8-18 V with 40 mA x 25 V output; 270 mA at 11.4-12.6 V with 60 mA x 25 V) and keep the derived P_in model.

Confirm the TPS2640 MODE-pin alternatives (402 kohm latch, short-to-GND current-limit auto-retry) from the MODE table before citing them; only MODE = OPEN = circuit breaker with auto-retry is confirmed for TPS26400.
Either cite the source of 'TI uses SN74LVC126A buffers on a 300 x 180 mm board' or remove the board dimension; the knowledge records give no board size.

summary: Source fact-check of the controller / auxiliary-supply / PWM-fault-logic / interconnect section. Primary datasheets were fetched and text-extracted for TPS2640 (SLVSFQ6A), UCC14141-Q1 (SLUSF10B), UCC21710-Q1 (SLUSDH8D), TMS320F28335 (SPRS439Q), SN74LV21A, AO3400A (AOS Rev 3.1) and Wurth 6130xx21121; ti.com product pages were checked for TPS54302, TPS767D3, TPS3808, SN74LVC2G08 and SN74LVC1G74 (all ACTIVE, revisions and dates as the agent stated). Every datasheet parameter the agent used for its eFuse, bias-budget, driver-interface and DSP-supply derivations was confirmed, the DSP pin map matches the V1 CSV, and all 24 cited knowledge IDs exist with the applicability/exclusion/conflict readings the agent reported; no reference instance value was copied. Two substantive errors: the UCC21710-Q1 APWM duty-vs-AIN direction is reversed (datasheet: 88 % at 0.6 V, 10 % at 4.5 V), which affects the OTP comparator sense and the firmware decode; and the TPS3808 105 k / 10 k divider yields about 4.66 V, not the stated 4.5 V. Minor corrections: several 'not found' values are in the datasheets (SN74LV21A 12 ns at 3.3 V, AO3400A 48 mohm at 2.5 V, TPS2640 threshold minima), the RST/EN pull-down is 55 k typ, the inrush combined-current expression is dimensionally inconsistent, and one board-size claim is unsourced. The remaining unverified items (TVS, Samtec, relay, TPS767D301PWPR lifecycle, V1 parts, SKILL/REF item numbering) are the ones the agent itself flagged; distributor data for the TVS and relay are internally consistent with the agent's values. 16 of 19 recomputations agree; the three disagreements do not change any selected part.
